name: Part 1: multiplies along a directed path
test: assert solution([('USD','CAD'),('CAD','EUR')],[2.0,1.5],'USD','EUR') == 3.0

name: Part 1: does not infer reverse rates
input: EUR to USD with only USD-to-EUR edges
test: assert solution([('USD','CAD'),('CAD','EUR')],[2.0,1.5],'EUR','USD') == -1.0

name: Part 1: same currency needs no edge
input: JPY to JPY with no pairs
test: assert solution([],[],'JPY','JPY') == 1.0

name: Part 1: handles a cycle without revisiting forever
input: A to C via a cycle

name: Part 2: indirect route beats the direct rate
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('A', 'C'), ('C', 'B')], [2.0, 4.0, 3.0], 'A', 'B'), 12.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: direct route can be optimal
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'C'), ('C', 'B'), ('A', 'B')], [2.0, 3.0, 8.0], 'A', 'B'), 8.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: fractional rates and floating-point products
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('A', 'C'), ('C', 'B')], [0.1, 0.3, 0.7], 'A', 'B'), 0.21, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: reverse rates are independent
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('USD', 'CAD'), ('CAD', 'USD')], [2.0, 0.4], 'CAD', 'USD'), 0.4, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: does not invent a reverse conversion
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('USD', 'CAD')], [2.0], 'CAD', 'USD'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: disconnected known currencies
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('C', 'D')], [2.0, 3.0], 'A', 'D'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: unknown source
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B')], [2.0], 'X', 'B'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: unknown destination
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B')], [2.0], 'A', 'X'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: empty graph with different endpoints
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([], [], 'A', 'B'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: same unknown currency
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([], [], 'JPY', 'JPY'), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: same currency cannot profit from a cycle
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('B', 'A')], [2.0, 3.0], 'A', 'A'), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: profitable cycle cannot repeat a currency
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('B', 'A'), ('B', 'C'), ('A', 'C')], [2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 1.0], 'A', 'C'), 8.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: self-loop cannot increase the rate
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'A'), ('A', 'B')], [4.0, 2.0], 'A', 'B'), 2.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: shared vertices must be reconsidered for each route
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('A', 'C'), ('C', 'B'), ('B', 'D')], [2.0, 4.0, 3.0, 2.0], 'A', 'D'), 24.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)

name: Part 2: smaller prefix can leave a better legal continuation
Part 2: cycle with unreachable destination terminates
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(best_rate([('A', 'B'), ('B', 'A'), ('C', 'D')], [2.0, 3.0, 4.0], 'A', 'D'), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
